gatoh.logging.LoggerVariables.get_fieldnames

LoggerVariables.get_fieldnames() → list[str][source]

A helper function that provides a place to collect and return all of the dataclass’ attribute names for use as CSV column names.

Returns:

The names of all the attributes in this dataclass.

Return type:

list[str]
